gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the cheapest kit per Wh under $5,000 that ships now is the ALLPOWERS R3500 + SP037 400 W at $0.50 per Wh ($1,586.73 / 3,168 Wh, 7.9 h of rated full sun to refill), or that at ALLPOWERS's own store the station and panel cost $8.68 less bought separately ($1,199 + $379.05 = $1,578.05) than the kit does through the link.
standout_why: The cited StormWatts same-panel-watts page (checked 2026-11-08) already gives price per Wh and sun-hours to refill, but only for 24 kits up to the Apex 300 + 2×500 W and DELTA 3800 Gen4 + 4×160 W. It has no ALLPOWERS kit, no Elite 400 kit, and no kit with an expansion battery (5.3–8.3 kWh), and its shipping states are 9 days old. StormWatts' 240V page (2026-11-16) has $/Wh for stations only, with no bundled panels. ChatGPT's answers showed only the Jackery, Anker, EcoFlow and BLUETTI Apex 300 kits and gave no $/Wh or shipping filter. I could not open theoutageready.com or solargenadvisor.com (TLS certificate errors) or solargenreview.com (HTTP 429), so I can't say what those pages state.
decides: The page rule says the pick must ship now. Among kits that ship now and are 3 kWh or larger, ALLPOWERS R3500 + SP037 400 W has the lowest price per Wh ($0.501). It costs well under half as much per Wh as the BLUETTI 5kWh RV Kit + 4×100 W ($0.798), the other kit we link that ships now at this size. The lowest prices per Wh overall are all pre-orders: BLUETTI Elite 400 + 350 W at $0.457/Wh (dispatch Dec 25, 2026) and Apex 200 + B300K + 2×200 W at $0.499/Wh for 5.3 kWh (late January 2027). Those are the options for a shopper who can wait. For the most capacity under $5,000, Apex 200 + B500K + 2×500 W gives 7.68 kWh at $0.519/Wh with a 7.7 h rated refill, but it is also a pre-order. EcoFlow's DELTA 3800 Gen4 + extra battery + 2×160 W is the closest rival in price per Wh ($0.516/Wh for 5.8 kWh), and its 320 W of panels need 18.2 h of rated sun to refill it. The R3500 kit through our link saves nothing over buying the two parts at ALLPOWERS's own no-code prices, so the page should not sell it as a bundle saving.
candidates: EcoFlow DELTA 3800 Gen4 + DELTA 3 Max Plus Extra Battery + 2×160 W
